<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow">Union Island villa, private suites and golf cart rental</span></p>
<h1 class="wp-block-heading">Ocean View Villa, Suites and Hotel-Style Accommodation on Union Island</h1>
<p class="hero__sub wp-block-paragraph">A private two-bedroom villa above the bay, with separate private suites below for guests who want their own entrance, patio, shared kitchen access, and the same Mayreau view. The property has direct views of Kite Beach, so you can watch the kites and read the wind before heading to the main spot, about a 7 minute golf cart ride away.</p>
<p class="hero__sub kg-mobile-hero-sub wp-block-paragraph">Beautiful views of the kite spot and the ocean at Mer &amp; Sel Villa and Suites, with private villa and suite options, easy access to Kite Beach by golf cart, and a windy Union Island accommodation base for your kite or wing holiday.</p>

<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow eyebrow--blue">Luxury Villa Mer et Sel &amp; Suites</span></p>
<h2 class="villa-h2 wp-block-heading">Mer &amp; Sel Villa and Suites</h2>
<p class="lead wp-block-paragraph">For your kitesurfing or wingfoiling holiday on Union Island, Mer et Sel Villa &amp; Suites is our premier accommodation option for guests staying and riding with us at JT Pro Center, about a 7 minute golf cart ride from the JT Pro Center spot.</p>
<p class="lead wp-block-paragraph">Perched above the island with stunning views over Mayreau and the Tobago Cays, the property offers a comfortable private villa and suite setup with Caribbean charm.</p>
<p class="lead wp-block-paragraph">Mer et Sel Villa &amp; Suites has a spacious villa on the upper level and private suites below, each with its own entrance, patio and bathroom. The villa and suites can be rented separately or together.</p>
</div></div>

<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow eyebrow--blue">Why book through JT Pro Center</span></p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Accommodation and riding logistics handled together.</h2>
<p class="lead center wp-block-paragraph">Share your dates, group size, and kite or wingfoil plans, and we help match the right Mer et Sel setup with the right lesson, rental, transport, and island logistics.</p>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Stay and ride in one plan</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Villa or suite enquiries can be coordinated with lessons, wing foiling, gear rental, and daily plans at the kite center.</p>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Clear local support</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We help guests choose the right room combination, transport option, and timing before arrival, with local knowledge from Union Island.</p>

<div class="wp-block-group reveal"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow eyebrow--blue room__eyebrow">The private villa</span></p>
<h2 class="room__title wp-block-heading">Luxury Mer et Sel Villa with Tobago Cays Views</h2>
<p class="kg-is-villa-accommodation-007 wp-block-paragraph">Villa Mer &amp; Sel looks directly toward Mayreau, the Tobago Cays, the JT Pro Center kite spot, and Union Island Salt Pond. It is about a 7 minute golf cart drive or a 15 minute walk to the JT Pro Center main kite spot and to the town center, where restaurants and bars are reopening for the season.</p>
<ul class="room__list wp-block-list">
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span>Two very large air-conditioned king bedrooms.</span></li>
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span>Each bedroom has a private bathroom, toilet, and balcony.</span></li>
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span>Large central living area with a fully equipped designer kitchen and oversized kitchen island.</span></li>
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span>Coffee and cocktail bar, wine cellar fridge, outdoor BBQ, lounge patio, large TV with Netflix and Spotify, and Starlink fast internet.</span></li>
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span>Daily housekeeping service included.</span></li>
        </ul>

<div class="wp-block-group reveal"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow eyebrow--blue room__eyebrow">Private suites</span></p>
<h2 class="room__title wp-block-heading">The Private Suites With Ocean View and Outdoor Patio</h2>
<p class="kg-is-villa-accommodation-009 wp-block-paragraph">The suites are located beneath the villa and have their own private entrances and patios. They are not included with the villa rental unless booked together. They are a clean option for guests who want the view, privacy, and access to a dedicated shared kitchen for the two suites without renting the full house.</p>
<ul class="room__list wp-block-list">
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span>Each suite is 305 sq ft, or 28 m².</span></li>
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span>King-size bed, walk-in bathroom, AC, small fridge, Nespresso coffee machine, kettle, Starlink internet, and daily housekeeping.</span></li>
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span>Guests can use the dedicated shared kitchen for the two suites on the same level.</span></li>
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span>Suites can be booked individually, together, or together with the villa.</span></li>
        </ul>
<div class="wp-block-group kg-is-villa-accommodation-010"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">

<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow eyebrow--blue room__eyebrow">Cozy room</span></p>
<h2 class="room__title wp-block-heading">A smaller add-on room when you need more flexibility.</h2>
<p class="kg-is-villa-accommodation-011 wp-block-paragraph">The Cozy Room is the smallest and most economical option. It is 176 sq ft, or 16 m², with its own private entrance, queen-size bed, walk-in bathroom, AC, small fridge, cleaning service, Starlink internet, and Nespresso coffee machine. Guests can use the shared kitchen on the same level. It can be booked individually or together with the villa, and it works well as an additional room for a suite or villa booking.</p>
</div></div>

<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow eyebrow--blue room__eyebrow">Golf carts and scooters</span></p>
<h2 class="room__title wp-block-heading">Reserve the villa and golf cart together.</h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Vehicle rentals require a driver&#8217;s license, ideally international. Three golf carts are available for rent to move easily between Mer &amp; Sel, town, and Kitebeach.</p>
<ul class="room__list wp-block-list">
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span><b>Villa and suite guest price:</b> Golf cart, 2 or 4-seater: US$60 per day. Scooter/Moped: US$40 per day.</span></li>
          <li><span class="ck">✓</span><span><b>Non-villa and non-suite guests:</b> Golf cart, 2 or 4-seater: US$100 per day.</span></li>
        </ul>

<div class="wp-block-group section-head"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow eyebrow--blue">Rates and booking notes</span></p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Seasonal rates for the villa, suites, and cozy room.</h2>
<p class="lead wp-block-paragraph">Contact JT Pro Center for last-minute and long-stay special discounts, or for other accommodation needs on Union Island. We sometimes have additional options available, and when guests reserve their stay through us, the Kitebeach launch fee is included.</p>
</div></div>

        <tr><th>August 1st to October 31st</th><td>550 USD/night</td><td>190 USD/night per suite</td><td>120 USD/night</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table></figure>
<p class="kg-is-villa-accommodation-014 wp-block-paragraph">Room rates are subject to an 11% government tax and an 8 EC$ (3 US$) per room per night environment fee.</p>

<p class="kg-inline-link wp-block-paragraph"><a class="tlink" href="https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/cancellation-policy/">View Mer &amp; Sel cancellation policy →</a></p>
</div></div>
</div></div>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-group section cta"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group wrap"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Ask about Mer &amp; Sel Villa, private suites, or golf cart rental.</h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Send your dates, group size, and whether you want lessons, wing foil, kite rentals, or Grenadines boat trips. JT Pro Center can help match the right stay with the right island logistics.</p>
